generator: Built-in image_gen tool via imagegen skill
preparation: Retain generated source PNGs unchanged. Center the generated alpha bounds (coverage >= 32) within a 64 x 64 canvas with a maximum 56-pixel visible dimension. Resize with high-quality bicubic filtering and retain the resized alpha as white tintable RGBA8 pixels. Menu glyphs render at 20 logical pixels with linear mipmap filtering and follow the shared button's animated text color.

icons.name: menu-import-images
icons.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: production desktop context-menu icon for Achimeld, matching its monochrome toolbar glyphs. Generate ONE flat monochrome WHITE UI glyph on a genuinely transparent background. Simple solid vector-icon appearance, balanced medium-bold visual weight, clean geometric edges and restrained large cutouts, clearly readable at 18 pixels. Center the complete symbol in a square canvas with roughly 12 percent empty margin on every side. No text, letters, labels, badge, button body, enclosing circle, shadows, gradients, textures or decoration. All strokes and filled shapes must be pure white with transparent cutouts. Subject: a landscape picture frame with a simple mountain and sun, with a bold downward import arrow at its lower right. One clear compact import-image symbol.
